agentUtterance.text:
My heart goes out to you for your loss. Please accept my deepest sympathies for you and your family during this difficult time.
I'm sorry to hear that. Have you tried using a tracking feature like "Find my iPhone" or "Find my Device"?
Understood. I would suggest temporarily suspending your service to prevent unauthorized use. I will send a text to the device you're calling from, with a link to do it yourself. Is that alright?

actionParameters.utterance: I lost my device when my father died

playbookOutput.executionSummary: VA asks user if they have tracked their phone. User denies so we suggest them to suspend their service and prompt them for SMS with link. User denies so we call SMS_flow with sms_send_status as "Declined"
